subject: world_language
concept: Understanding virtually everything read or heard in the target language, including subtle implication and connotation
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR C2 'understand with ease virtually everything' descriptor — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a subtly worded statement to the implied meaning beneath its literal words
exercise.abstract: Student explains the subtle implication or connotation carried by a described target-language statement

misconception_flags: interprets a statement only at the literal level, missing its subtler implied meaning

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
